svg.title: Enterprise integration on Azure
svg.desc: Enterprise integration on Azure. 10 components in 3 groups. Connections: Client application to Microsoft Entra ID; Client application to API Management (HTTPS); API Management to Logic Apps; Logic Apps to Azure Service Bus (send); Azure Service Bus to Azure Event Grid (messages waiting); Azure Event Grid to Logic Apps (trigger); Azure Service Bus to Logic Apps (peek-lock receive); Logic Apps to SaaS service; Logic Apps to Azure SQL Database; Azure Service Bus to Message-based service (topic subscription).

text.tspan: API Management fronts Logic Apps workflows that decouple back-end systems through Service Bus, with Event Grid waking the consumer when messages wait
